en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 5.Ibn Abī al-Bilād narrated from the one who informed him, from one of the learned scholars who said, “

The poor believers will be stopped on the Day of Judgment and will be told by the Lord, Blessed and Exalted is He, ‘Indeed I did not make you poor due to your insignificance in My eyes; rather, I made you poor to test you. Go forth, and let there be no one who did good to you in the world but that you take his hand and make him enter Paradise [with you].’”
